newsitem.title: EGYPT: EU envoy in peace talks with Egypt's Mubarak.
newsitem.headline: EU envoy in peace talks with Egypt's Mubarak.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak met the European Union's Middle East envoy Miguel Angel Moratinos on Sunday for talks on the peace process.

Moratinos, who is also Spain's ambassador to Israel, told reporters that the 15-nation bloc had already proposed "confidence building" mechanisms to bring the Arab and Israeli peace partners closer togther but that he would only propose more concrete decisions after he had met all sides involved.
"We are very much concerned about the situation," he said. "There is still some work to be done, we have to narrow the gaps between Palestinians and Israel."

Moratinos said Europe hoped both sides would soon reach a solution on a long-delayed Israeli troop withdrawal from Hebron, the last town in the occupied West Bank to be handed back to Palestinian self rule.

Palestinian-Israeli peace talks are deadlocked over the troop withdrawal which the Jewish state wants to modify for security concerns. The Palestinians refuse to change the pullout deal they reached with the previous Israeli government.
Moratinos, who flew into Cairo on Saturday after talks in Damascus, has already held talks with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Israeli officials.
